I wrote `/home/dev/21787a/app/notes/preview-controls.json` with `{ "drag": false, "wheel": false, "pinch": true }`. Per your notes, on the static preview page a mouse drag or wheel turn only adds to the inertia offsets, which are applied by a render-loop hook that never runs there, so they leave `alpha`, `beta` and `radius` unchanged. A two-finger pinch writes `radius` immediately, so QA should expect pinch to zoom even without a render loop.

I'm not fully certain of this. The answer rests entirely on `camera-notes.md`, since the `.d.ts` only shows signatures and I couldn't check the library source. I also didn't check whether a single-finger touch drag on a tablet behaves like a mouse drag, or whether a pinch changes `alpha` or `beta` as well as `radius`; the notes only mention `radius`.
